upgrade.sql: CREATE TABLE bot_memory (memory_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT DEFAULT 'memory' NOT NULL, context_ref TEXT, subject_ref TEXT, kind TEXT, sensitivity TEXT, retention TEXT, content TEXT NOT NULL, content_format TEXT DEFAULT 'text/plain' NOT NULL, query_tags TEXT, metadata_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (memory_id))
CREATE INDEX bot_memory_context_idx ON bot_memory (context_ref, subject_ref)
CREATE INDEX bot_memory_scope_idx ON bot_memory (scope, created_at)

CREATE TABLE bot_behavior (name TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, examples_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL, status_reason TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, status_updated_at TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, used_count TEXT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, last_used_at TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, failed_count TEXT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, last_failed_at TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, created_at TEXT DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (name))

CREATE TABLE bot_behavior_trigger (behavior_name TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (behavior_name, "trigger"), FOREIGN KEY(behavior_name) REFERENCES bot_behavior (name) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE bot_stm_memory (stm_id TEXT NOT NULL, stimulus_name TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, event_id TEXT, source TEXT, target TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_accessed_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (stm_id))
CREATE INDEX bot_stm_memory_recent_idx ON bot_stm_memory (stimulus_name, created_at)
